name: UGC 7512 (Hubble)
blurb: UGC 7512, an irregular dwarf galaxy in front of the Virgo Cluster, seen by Hubble.
label: ugc07512-hubble
story: A small irregular dwarf galaxy hanging in front of the great Virgo Cluster. Hubble measured its distance from its brightest red giant stars, helping trace how galaxies here are falling toward the cluster.

claims.text: UGC 07512 is a target of Hubble program 12878, 'The Near Edge of Infall into the Virgo Cluster', which measures TRGB distances to galaxies in front of Virgo
UGC 7512 is an irregular type dwarf galaxy
New TRGB distances place UGC 7512 in front of the Virgo Cluster
Distances and velocities of these galaxies exhibit infall toward the Virgo Cluster
